title: Anyone else?
content: Hi there. I’m new here and just stumbled upon this whole world recently. I have (within the last year) had multiple dreams about being in a mall. It was empty, I think. Although, it seemed there was always someone there, either with me, or in the vicinity that I couldn’t see. I was always trying to find a way out of the mall, but never could. I have a vague feeling that a clown or clowns are involved, possibly in a sinister way, but idk. The lights and I think music were on, but it was like the mall was empty and I was just wondering around trying to escape. I remember giant escalators, lots of gold and glass and lights. Maybe it was Christmas time? I found my way into a back room that seemed to have a door to the outside, but it was made of cement, felt cold and was too heavy to budge. I think I have had quite a few dreams in this mall. All similar, but I don’t remember much more than this. I have started to get anxiety at night before I go to bed and I was telling my husband the other night that I “am just so afraid, I don’t want to go back there, it’s so exhausting.” Even though I don’t feel like this until it’s almost time to sleep and I start to panic. Before I ever even voiced any of this to him he tried to comfort me one night and said “you don’t have anything to be afraid of”, which made me even more stressed because HOW DID HE KNOW I WAS AFRAID?? He said he just had a feeling. I specifically didn’t read any posts here before posting myself, I’ve seen a couple YouTube videos about this after my brother asked me if I was in gate and I replied “I don’t remember”. Which is how I ended up here. WTH?! I’m a bit shaken to be real with ya’ll. I didn’t want to read more scary stuff and then bring it into my experiences, so I’m just offering this to see if anyone else is in the same boat, or has similar experiences. I don’t want to give this thing more power, but I also want to know if it’s real. I’m missing large chunks of my childhood. I always just thought I had a bad memory. Maybe not? 😫
